items.title: Prediction: Qualcomm Becomes the Top Auto Chipmaker in 2027, “a Story the Market Has Quietly Ignored,” per SemiAnalysis
items.summary: Key TakeawaysQualcomm’s (QCOM:NASDAQ) auto revenue reached $2 billion in its September quarter, up 89%, and SemiAnalysis predicts it will pass Infineon (IFNNY) and NXP Semiconductors (NXPI:NASDAQ) in 2027 to become the largest auto chipmaker. The growth comes from more Qualcomm content in each car, so it doesn’t depend on car sales.

items.title: Could Monolithic Power Stock Drop 30% Again?
items.summary: The one number a Monolithic Power Systems holder should watch is free cash flow. That is the cash left after running the business and paying for new equipment. Over the twelve months to September 2026 it came to $606 million, down from $705 million a year earlier. Revenue rose 40.5% over the same twelve months.
